guitar.modelsText: Ernie Ball Music Man John Petrucci signature
models: Ernie Ball Music Man John Petrucci signature
guitar.evidence: John Petrucci's Music Man (now Ernie Ball Music Man) signature guitar line is extremely well documented and closely tied to his identity as a progressive metal guitarist.

tone.target: liquid high-gain lead with polished 90s prog sustain
tone.profile: liquid high-gain lead with polished 90s prog sustain
tone.summary: A modern prog rock chain utilizing a Boost for attack definition, a powerful Mesa/Boogie style gain (Recti), coupled with an AC30 TB to maintain clarity, finished with Chorus and Digital Delay for polish and space.

rig.name: Dream Theater - Scene Eight_ The Spirit Carries On - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up high-gain noise and maintain tight articulation.
Enhance pick attack and lead voice presence (TS Boost emulation).
Provide high-gain foundation (Mesa/Boogie style) without excessive fuzz or scoop.
blocks.gap: The Recti model is better for pure Mesa, but Distortion provides the necessary modern high-gain structure and articulation required for prog rock lead work.

alternatives.reason: If available, Recti would be ideal for the specific Mesa tone.

blocks.purpose: Simulate the powerful, articulate high-gain tone required for prog lead work.
Provide a clear, articulate platform for the high-gain lead tone.
blocks.gap: The UK Vintage 4x12 offers clarity and punch suitable for modern prog rock leads.

alternatives.reason: Could offer a slightly more open, complex sound.

blocks.purpose: Add polish and width to arpeggios and sustained notes.
Add rhythmic space and polish without excessive wet ambience.
Provide subtle space and sustain without sounding overly wet or ambient.
Sculpt the tone for smooth lead mids and articulate high end.

improvements.summary: Upgrade the cabinet simulation for better realism and open sound required by prog leads.

proposals.reason: The current cabinet is too closed; a more open, complex IR will improve realism.
proposals.expectedGain: Increased clarity and openness in the high end.
